# ArnavPuri/designskills

- **Link:** https://github.com/ArnavPuri/designskills
- **License:** MIT (© 2026 Arnav Puri). Every skill has `license: MIT` in its frontmatter.
- **Status (2026-10-10):** v1.1.0 (released 2026-09-28), 11 stars. Small but carefully engineered.
- **Type:** a Claude Code marketplace (`.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`) containing one plugin, `designskills`, with **28 skills**. It has no commands, agents, hooks or MCP. Helper scripts live in each skill's `scripts/` folder.

## Skills (28)

**Output key:** Gem = image generated by Gemini; Code = HTML/CSS.

| Group | Skill | Output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Foundational | design-context (finds brand info and saves it to `.agents/design-context.md`) | Markdown + contrast.py |
| | image-generation (Gemini: text-to-image, edit, multi-turn) | Gem |
| Graphic | graphic-design, social-media-graphic, poster-design, thumbnail-design, ad-creative-design (incl. HTML5 animated ads), product-mockup, infographic, banner-design | Gem or Code (infographic defaults to Code + SVG) |
| UI | ui-design, landing-page-design, dashboard-design, mobile-ui-design, hero-section, card-design, dark-mode, email-design | Code |
| Design systems | color-palette (OKLCH), typography, layout-composition, brand-identity, icon-design, design-system (DTCG tokens) | Code / SVG / JSON |
| Process | design-critique, motion-design (UI motion only, "not video"), presentation-design (reveal.js, PDF), image-treatment | Code / report |

## Image generation

- **Script:** `skills/image-generation/scripts/gemini-generate.py`, using the `google-genai` SDK. The model is hardcoded to `gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview`.
- **Setup:** needs `GEMINI_API_KEY` and `pip install google-genai Pillow`.
- **Features:** up to 14 reference images, aspect ratio and size options (512 to 4K), exact-pixel crop with `--resize`, multi-turn edits with `--then`. `export-sizes.py` crops one master image into every platform size.
- **No provider abstraction:** there is no alternative to Gemini, and `static_checks.py` enforces the model id.
- **Rendering and critique:** need Playwright Chromium. Windows hasn't been tested.

## Keep

- **Shared brand context file.** Every skill reads `.agents/design-context.md`. design-context fills it automatically from Tailwind configs, CSS variables, shadcn, DTCG tokens and Figma.
- **Routing lines in descriptions.** Each skill says "use X instead of Y" so the right skill triggers.
- **Render and look before delivering.**
- **design-critique procedure:**
  - capture at 375, 768 and 1440 px plus dark mode
  - cite evidence for every finding
  - four severity levels
  - weighted score with caps ("an open Critical caps overall at 6")
  - re-capture to verify the fix
- **Text-fixing tactics for images:** "Change 'EVERYTHNG' to 'EVERYTHING'. Change nothing else." After two failed fixes, switch to a code overlay.
- **Three-layer eval harness:**
  - static lint
  - routing eval against 60 trigger cases, run through the API or real `claude -p`
  - 10 headless end-to-end tasks with deterministic checks, an optional rubric judge, and a `--baseline` run without the skills

## Gaps

- **Single model.** Locked to one Gemini preview model.
- **Web/UI focus.** No real illustration, drawing, video or animation production.
- **Generic sections.** Some parts are generic lists, such as style archetypes and color psychology.
- **Network dependency.** `audit.mjs` loads axe-core from a CDN unless it's installed locally.

## Overlap

- **open-design:** high. Landing, dashboard, deck, poster and design-system skills duplicate each other.
- **Brand skills:** high. brand-identity, palette, typography and context overlap directly.
- **SVG skills:** low to medium.

## Proposed use

**adapt.** Make it the backbone of the **design** plugin:

- Use the design-context pattern as the shared brand context for the whole marketplace.
- Move image generation behind our provider layer, so users bring their own key and model.
- Adopt the eval harness for every plugin.
